data.text: Welcome, Luke. I’m Jack—my family taught me to fish here, and I want this lake to keep supporting the village. I’m happy to commit to 10 tons this month if everyone agrees to the same limit. That gives each of us $10,000 while leaving enough fish to refill the lake. Let’s check our catches together each month and adjust if the stock drops. John, does that fit how you’ve been handling things?
